attacks.name: X-Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change one of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Tornado Claw
steps: After all attacks generated by this attack have been resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the last character targeted by this attack.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change one of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: What I Do Isn‘t Very Nice
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an X-Slash attack action. After the attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw the defender |!range_small|. This superpower may be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Adamantium Skeleton
superPowers.body: When determining whether this character can be Thrown or Pushed by an effect or special rule or when it is colliding with another character or terrain feature, this character counts as |!size| 3.

superPowers.name: Get Out of my Head!
superPowers.body: The first time this character is damaged by an enemy |!mystic| attack each turn, after the attack is resolved, other allied characters within |!range| 3 of this character suffer 1 |!damage|. Characters that suffer |!damage| this way gain 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: On the Hunt
superPowers.body: When this character makes an attack, if there are no allied characters within |!range| 3 of it, this character may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice.
